Why are people so fixated on attributing the "origin" of video games on film or TV when it is obvious that the essence of gaming comes directly from board games and sports?

These attempts at making video games more like movies are the actual disruption. You guessed it, I don't quite like those personally. And I don't want to see the medium being mixed with things that frankly would be better categorized as movies. I'd rather have the word "video game" actually mean something, as opposed to "art".

Terms like "walking simulator" inherit their derogatory nature from the widespread notion that they are by and large terrible entertainment, regardless of categorization. Other than that, it is an accurate description of the game, and the most useful piece of labeling information about such a game.
